reason: Crash Bandicoot incorrectly received 100 points. Audit found roster-order tie breaking and unrelated-question ratings had put other familiar answers at the top.
scope: All 240 question rating extremes reviewed; all unanchored answers receive neutral 50 rather than an invented rarity ranking.
compatibility: Question IDs, membership, schedule and formula unchanged. All older captured scores and results remain frozen.
